BiblicalUsage: bebaioo covers to confirm, to establish, and it appears 8 times across the Bible. Paul says God confirmed the testimony of Christ among the Corinthians, and the Lord confirmed the word with signs following.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God does not leave His promises vague — He confirms them, and a confirmed word is one I can stand on. That is why I keep coming back to it: bebaioo is not a word to rush past.
